summary: Final implementation plan for ArchResidenceBD, incorporating the existing GitHub repository (sazid63/ArchResidenceBD) and Hugging Face model fleet (sazid63/archresidencebd-models). Covers finishing and polishing the app, making the Web and Windows app seamlessly functional, resolving the IPC core bridge for browser preview and cloud hosting, enhancing the 4-model AI fleet (incorporating archres-repair-v0 and fixing Qwen3-Reranker templates), connecting NativeCAD 3D visualization, and providing the Windows installer packaging pipeline.
